title: DIY Concrete Garden Lamp (Modern Outdoor Lighting)
excerpt: A modern concrete garden lamp built with simple materials, combining durability with a clean outdoor aesthetic.
body:
## Overview
In this project I built a modern concrete garden lamp using simple materials and a custom mold.

Concrete is an excellent material for outdoor lighting due to its durability, resistance to weather and its clean, natural look.

## Concept & Design
The goal was to create a minimal and robust garden lamp that blends naturally with outdoor environments.

By using basic shapes and a smooth finish, the final result achieves a modern and understated design.

## Materials Used
To build this project you will need:

- PET bottle (for mold shaping)
- Flexible corrugated pipe
- Styrofoam
- Duct tape
- Concrete mix
- Thin sand
- Plywood
- Hot glue and superglue

## Electrical Components
For the lighting system:

- Ceramic GU10 fitting with bayonet connection
- GU10 LED lamp
- Electric power cable

These components provide a compact and efficient lighting solution suitable for outdoor conditions.

## Build Process
The project starts by creating a custom mold using everyday materials such as bottles and styrofoam.

After preparing the mold, the concrete mixture is poured and compacted carefully to avoid air bubbles.

Once cured, the mold is removed and the surface is cleaned and refined.

## Finishing & Assembly
After curing, the electrical components are installed and secured.

Attention must be given to insulation and proper cable routing to ensure safety and durability.

## Final Result
The final piece is a solid and modern outdoor lamp that is both decorative and functional.

Concrete gives the lamp a premium feel while ensuring long-term resistance to outdoor elements.

## Plans & Downloads
If you want to build your own version, you can download the full project files below:

- SketchUp 3D model
- Printable PDF plans
- Cut details and measurements
